    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理(3.大模型绕不开的架构--Transformer到底是怎么工作的?)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">最近正好有空,打算抽时间复盘总结一下这些年零零散散学习的AI知识.</p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">下面是目录</p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20983335">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理目录 - GuZhenYin - 博客园</a></p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">如果说上一章介绍的是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="567" data-end="581">
<p data-start="569" data-end="581"><strong data-start="569" data-end="581">模型吃进去什么。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="583" data-end="594">那么这一章介绍的就是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="596" data-end="616">
<p data-start="598" data-end="616"><strong data-start="598" data-end="616">模型的大脑到底是如何工作的。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="c8bqg9" data-start="517" data-end="543">&nbsp;</h1>
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="c8bqg9" data-start="517" data-end="543">第三章 Transformer 到底是怎么工作的</h1>
<p data-start="618" data-end="651">很多介绍 Transformer 的文章，一开始就是下面这张公式：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/653851/202606/653851-20260630163904898-901450200.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p data-start="719" data-end="736">看到这里，绝大多数兄弟已经放弃了。</p>
<p data-start="738" data-end="780">事实上，即使不知道任何数学公式，也完全可以理解 Transformer 的核心思想。</p>
<p data-start="782" data-end="835">这一章，我们不用矩阵、向量运算这些复杂公式来表述，而是用一个现实例子，说明模型到底是如何"思考"一段文字的。</p>
<hr data-start="837" data-end="840">
<h2 data-section-id="1rnvj04" data-start="842" data-end="855">3.1 从一句话开始</h2>
<p data-start="857" data-end="870">假设我们给模型输入一句话：</p>
<blockquote data-start="872" data-end="891">
<p data-start="874" data-end="891">小明昨天去北京出差，今天他回来了。</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="893" data-end="897">然后问：</p>
<blockquote data-start="899" data-end="907">
<p data-start="901" data-end="907">"他"是谁？</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="909" data-end="923">对于我们人类来说，答案非常简单。</p>
<p data-start="925" data-end="929">当然是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="931" data-end="936">
<p data-start="933" data-end="936">小明。</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="938" data-end="953">但是，如果你仔细思考，会发现句子里面其实并没有写：</p>
<blockquote data-start="968" data-end="977">
<p data-start="970" data-end="977">他 = 小明。</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="979" data-end="992">我们的大脑为什么能够知道？</p>
<p data-start="994" data-end="997">因为我们会自动回忆前面的内容。</p>
<p data-start="1014" data-end="1017">发现：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1019" data-end="1023">
<p data-start="1021" data-end="1023">小明</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1025" data-end="1026">和</p>
<blockquote data-start="1028" data-end="1031">
<p data-start="1030" data-end="1031">他</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1033" data-end="1039">关系最紧密。</p>
<p data-start="1041" data-end="1044">于是理解了"他"就是小明。</p>
<p data-start="1065" data-end="1089">Transformer 做的事情，其实非常类似。</p>
<p data-start="1091" data-end="1095">它也会<strong data-start="1097" data-end="1105">回头看,</strong>不过它不是只看一个词。</p>
<p data-start="1123" data-end="1126">而是看前面的所有 Token。</p>
<hr data-start="1143" data-end="1146">
<h2 data-section-id="pqlfnw" data-start="1148" data-end="1184">3.2 Transformer 为什么叫 Transformer？</h2>
<p data-start="1186" data-end="1195">很多人第一次看到：Transformer。</p>
<p data-start="1211" data-end="1215">都会问,为什么叫Transformer？</p>
<p data-start="1238" data-end="1242">是不是它的直译--变形金刚？(哈哈哈 开个玩笑..)</p>
<p data-start="1251" data-end="1254">其实Transformer 的中文一般翻译为：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1279" data-end="1289">
<p data-start="1281" data-end="1289"><strong data-start="1281" data-end="1289">转换器。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1291" data-end="1299">为什么叫转换器？</p>
<p data-start="1291" data-end="1299"><strong>因为它不断地把一串 Token,逐渐转换成越来越丰富的语义表示。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1348" data-end="1353">举个例子,刚开始,模型看到：<code>苹果</code></p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>它只知道这是一个 Token。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1404" data-end="1410">经过第一层它开始知道这是：水果。</p>
<p data-start="1430" data-end="1436">再经过几层。</p>
<p data-start="1438" data-end="1442">它知道这里说的是：苹果公司。</p>
<p data-start="1459" data-end="1466">继续经过几层。</p>
<p data-start="1468" data-end="1472">它发现上下文出现：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>iPhone<br>Mac<br>Apple Store</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1518" data-end="1521">于是最终理解这里的苹果,不是水果。</p>
<p data-start="1518" data-end="1521">而是：Apple 公司。</p>
<p data-start="1564" data-end="1567">注意,这里Token 没变,变化的是模型内部对它的理解。</p>
<p data-start="1599" data-end="1602">所以Transformer真正转换的不是文字。</p>
<p data-start="1630" data-end="1633">而是,<strong data-start="1635" data-end="1655">每一个 Token 的语义表示。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1630" data-end="1633">那么Transformer是怎么转换token的语义的呢?</p>
<p data-start="1630" data-end="1633">下面我们分步骤讲.</p>
<p data-start="1630" data-end="1633">&nbsp;</p>
<hr data-start="1657" data-end="1660">
<h2 data-section-id="ux8jmf" data-start="1662" data-end="1682">3.3 第一步：Embedding</h2>
<p data-start="1684" data-end="1688">上一节,我们提到：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>苹果<br>↓<br>Token ID<br>↓<br>31582</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1736" data-end="1744">这里很多人会问模型直接处理31582不行吗？</p>
<p data-start="1768" data-end="1771">答案是不行。</p>
<p data-start="1778" data-end="1782">为什么？</p>
<p data-start="1784" data-end="1787">因为31582只是编号,这种编号太短,可存储内容太少,表示的语义也有限。</p>
<p data-start="1807" data-end="1818">而且编号之间没有任何关系。</p>
<p data-start="1820" data-end="1823">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>苹果<br>31582<br>香蕉<br>712<br>北京<br>89231</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1868" data-end="1874">从数字来看,31582和712没有任何联系。</p>
<p data-start="1900" data-end="1903">但是,我们人类知道苹果和香蕉都属于水果。</p>
<p data-start="1935" data-end="1940">它们应该更接近。</p>
<p data-start="1948" data-end="1951">因此,模型需要把Token ID变成一种新的表示。</p>
<p data-start="1986" data-end="1988"><strong>它就是：Embedding（词向量）。</strong></p>
<p data-start="2007" data-end="2015">可以把它理解成：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2017" data-end="2047">
<p data-start="2019" data-end="2047"><strong data-start="2019" data-end="2047">模型给每一个 Token 建立的一张"身份证"。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2049" data-end="2052">不过这张身份证不是姓名,住址,出生年月这些。</p>
<p data-start="2072" data-end="2080">而是一大串数字.例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>苹果<br><br>↓<br><br>[0.13,<br>-0.42,<br>0.78,<br>......]</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2135" data-end="2143">在大模型里面,可能一个token有几千维这些数字。</p>
<p data-start="2164" data-end="2169">共同描述：苹果这个词在语言世界里的位置。</p>
<hr data-start="2188" data-end="2191">
<h2 data-section-id="1soaj16" data-start="2193" data-end="2211">3.4 为什么叫"向量空间"？</h2>
<p data-start="2213" data-end="2220">很多文章都会说：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2222" data-end="2241">
<p data-start="2224" data-end="2241">Token 被映射到高维向量空间。</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2243" data-end="2251">听起来特别抽象,其实你可以想象成一张地图。(当然 地图最多也就三维空间)</p>
<p data-start="2273" data-end="2277">地图上每一个 Token都有自己的坐标。</p>
<p data-start="2301" data-end="2304">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/653851/202607/653851-20260701082254344-820332264.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2385" data-end="2388">当然,真正的大模型完全不是二维。</p>
<p data-start="2406" data-end="2409">而是几千维。</p>
<p data-start="2417" data-end="2420">但是,原理一样,距离越近说明语义越接近。</p>
<p data-start="2449" data-end="2452">例如模型可能发现：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>北京<br>上海<br>广州</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2483" data-end="2488">在向量空间中距离很近。</p>
<p data-start="2490" data-end="2493">因为它们都是城市。</p>
<p data-start="2505" data-end="2507">而：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Redis<br>MySQL<br>Kafka</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2538" data-end="2542">也很近。</p>
<p data-start="2544" data-end="2547">因为它们作为技术中间件经常出现在同样的上下文。</p>
<p data-start="2568" data-end="2571">注意:模型并没有人告诉它,Redis 是数据库。</p>
<p data-start="2598" data-end="2602">它只是统计发现Redis、Kafka、MySQL、Spring Boot经常一起出现。</p>
<p data-start="2658" data-end="2661">于是通过大量的训练和计算,慢慢的这些 Token就在空间里面越来越近。</p>
<hr data-start="2695" data-end="2698">
<h2 data-section-id="eligwr" data-start="2700" data-end="2725">3.5 Transformer 最重要的一步--<strong data-start="3122" data-end="3143">Attention(注意力机制)</strong></h2>
<p data-start="2727" data-end="2732">到了这里,模型已经拥有了每一个 Token 的Embedding。</p>
<p data-start="2770" data-end="2774">接下来,神奇的事情发生了。</p>
<p data-start="2789" data-end="2804">Transformer 会问：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2806" data-end="2846">
<p data-start="2808" data-end="2846"><strong data-start="2808" data-end="2846">当前我要预测下一个 Token 时，前面的哪些 Token 最重要？</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2848" data-end="2851">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>小明<br>昨天<br>去了<br>北京<br>今天<br>他回来了。<br><br>他是谁?</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2884" data-end="2889">准备开始预测：</p>
<p data-start="2891" data-end="2896">后面一句Transformer 会按token依次<strong data-start="3215" data-end="3247">计算</strong>：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">

<p data-start="3018" data-end="3021">最终模型发现和"他"关系最大的。其实是：小明。</p>
<p data-start="3058" data-end="3061">于是模型就知道"他"大概率指的是小明。</p>
<p data-start="3090" data-end="3094">这一步。就是Transformer 最伟大的发明：</p>
<p data-start="3122" data-end="3143"><strong data-start="3122" data-end="3143">Attention（注意力机制）。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3145" data-end="3151">很多人认为Attention就是让模型注意重点。</p>
<p data-start="3183" data-end="3186">其实更准确一点说Attention 做的是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="3213" data-end="3247">
<p data-start="3215" data-end="3247"><strong data-start="3215" data-end="3247">计算每一个 Token 对当前 Token 的影响程度。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="3249" data-end="3302">后面一节，我们将专门讲解 Attention 是如何工作的，以及为什么它彻底改变了自然语言处理的发展方向。</p>
<hr data-start="3304" data-end="3307">
<h1 data-section-id="njsg9h" data-start="3309" data-end="3321">本章小结（第一部分）</h1>
<p data-start="3323" data-end="3341">这一部分，我们讲了三个关键概念：</p>
<ol data-start="3343" data-end="3512">
<li data-section-id="13l65ps" data-start="3343" data-end="3389"><strong data-start="3346" data-end="3389">Transformer 并不是直接处理文字，而是处理 Token 的语义表示。</strong></li>
<li data-section-id="qhamjd" data-start="3390" data-end="3440"><strong data-start="3393" data-end="3440">Embedding 不是普通编号，而是让语义相近的 Token 在高维空间中彼此靠近。</strong></li>
<li data-section-id="11wur1e" data-start="3441" data-end="3512"><strong data-start="3444" data-end="3512">Transformer 的核心思想不是死记硬背，而是在生成每一个 Token 时，动态决定应该重点关注前文中的哪些 Token。</strong></li>
</ol><hr data-start="3514" data-end="3517">
<h2 data-section-id="85hqyu" data-start="3519" data-end="3526">说明</h2>
<p data-start="3528" data-end="3560">这里特意<strong data-start="3533" data-end="3559">没有讲 Q、K、V，也没讲任何矩阵公式</strong>。</p>
<p data-start="3562" data-end="3634">因为我们要先理解 <strong data-start="3573" data-end="3620">Transformer 为什么需要 Embedding、为什么需要 Attention</strong>，再去学习它们是如何实现的。</p>
<p data-start="3636" data-end="3725">下一章我们开始学习<strong data-start="3573" data-end="3620">Transformer 的核心模块之一</strong> <strong>Attention</strong>&nbsp;，我们会讲到&nbsp;<strong data-start="3665" data-end="3693">Q（Query）、K（Key）、V（Value）</strong>，那时它们就不会再是三个生硬的字母参数，而是三个非常容易理解的角色。</p>

</div>
